purpose: Official 2021 registered municipal resident population for seven Sierra Bermeja incident municipalities; source sidecar for parent integration.

geography.code_system: INE five-digit municipality code: two-digit province plus three-digit municipality; leading zeros preserved as strings

measure.name: official_registered_municipal_population
measure.definition: Residents registered in the municipal Padrón, official annual revision; both sexes combined.

dates.publication_caveat: The January 2021 reference date is not the publication date. These official figures were released after the September 2021 Sierra Bermeja incident. The downloaded file is a current historical series, not a preserved original 2021 release snapshot.

sources.title: Málaga: Población por municipios y sexo.
sources.operation: Cifras oficiales de población de los municipios españoles: Revisión del Padrón Municipal

observed_download_url_evidence.observation: Catalog semicolon-separated CSV distribution links directly to this exact INE URL; no download URL was constructed or guessed.

sources.encoding_note: Payload decodes strictly as utf-8-sig despite the different HTTP charset label; accented municipal names are retained.
sources.raw_vintage: Current provincial historical series acquired in 2026; includes 2021 rows and later years. Later-year values were not substituted.

sources.evidence: Lists INE table 2882, the exact CSV distribution URL, Málaga geographic scope, annual frequency and current-series update date. Used for discovery and metadata, not municipal counts.
2021 official Padrón results index lists last modification 23/12/2021 for population tables. INE publication catalog also assigns the 01/01/2021 edition to December 2021.

INE defines the Padrón as the administrative register of municipal residents and the annual official municipal population by sex as referring to 1 January. Table 2882 explicitly labels units Personas.

Royal Decree 1065/2021 was published on 2021-12-23, declares the 2021-01-01 Padrón figures official with effects from 2021-12-31, and gives Málaga provincial total 1695651. Used for release timing and provincial cross-check, not municipal counts.

extraction.parsing: Read unchanged raw CSV with Python csv.DictReader, delimiter semicolon, encoding utf-8-sig. Split Municipios at the first space; preserve the code as a string. Remove dot thousands separators from Total and parse an integer. Require one matching total per municipality.
extraction.source_line_number_convention: One-based physical CSV line including the header; every data record occupies one line.

constraints.actor_input_ineligibility_reason: Official publication followed the September 2021 incident, and municipal resident totals do not establish incident exposure or evacuation demand.
constraints.historical_replay_not_ready_reason: Current historical series is not an as-of-incident snapshot; no incident-specific exposed population or settlement allocation has been established.
constraints.scope: Only this JSON and the ignored raw acquisition directory were written. No simulator, agents, credentials, paid services, training, commits, pushes, posts or messages were used.
constraints.acquisition_notes: Initial sandbox DNS lookup failed; the same observed public INE CSV URL downloaded successfully after approved network escalation. Raw HTTP headers were discarded to avoid retaining response cookies; only non-sensitive selected response metadata is recorded. No applicable AGENTS.md was found at /, /tmp, the sidecar repository root, or under data and .runtime.
